verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents some event-driven automatic behaviors: incoming alerts are grouped into cases, a configuration setting adds the official Financial Institution to manually created cases, and the vendor can configure workflows that mirror customer policies. Marketing also mentions 'customizable automation'. But there is no evidence that users can author their own trigger-action rules; configuration appears to be done by the vendor ('We can...'). The 90-day pending review is a timed schedule, not an event trigger. missing for 10: user-facing rule builder for defining event triggers and actions, documentation of available trigger events and action types, self-serve rule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
